author: Cosmo

honesty.statement: Colour constants only. Body variants 1-3 are SEEDED from the recorded ibm_marrakesh run through sha256 streams (recorded hardware counts as the seed, not live quantum). Nothing here was tested in the live engine, on a phone or on a GBA. The wake is decoration.

color_space: hex = sRGB; baseColorFactor / linear fields are linear light and authoritative; blends in linear light

15_roadster.jpg.note: 3x3 mean of the car body, cross-check only

17_roadster_parked.jpg.note: parked, warm headlamps, crystal lamp beside it

materials_in_glb.trim: vertex COLOR_0 carries tyre/chrome/seat colours; seat tint may be multiplied by seat_hex at runtime
materials_in_glb.glow: emissive set per node role: headlamp_warm / underglow_mood / bauble_cyan

headlamps.note: Headlamps glow warm. Colours reuse the landscape lamp ramp (landscapes_look.json lamp.by_mode). Parked next to a crystal lamp (Studio 17_roadster_parked) the car sits at the shelter warmth, dimmed.

cone.note: real SpotLights only for the car the camera follows; others use the glow sprite

underglow.note: Underglow ring: one emissive colour per state, cage mood colours from livingworld/coexist/moods.json. Multiply white by this, additive, peak 1.4 linear at boost.

bauble.note: cyan = curious mood colour; wireframe is a light layer only, no networks drawn

wake.note: Stardust wake: Studio's 15_roadster shows a violet strand with an amber strand twisting behind the car. Both ramps reuse the boom SHELL path of sky_palette.json (anchor 10000 K, t 0 = hot head -> t 1 = ember) and pull its hot end toward cage violet / lamp amber in LINEAR light. The engine's own boomState / blackBodyToRGB win wherever it has a number; these are stand-in constants.

sparkle.note: 3% of wake particles flash white (#FFFFFF) for one frame, like the shell filament specks

param.note: two strands twist round each other; head spawns at the rear axle, ramp t = age/life

wake.label: SEEDED (stepped test universe) when drawn with boom colours; the wake is decoration, not a recorded phenomenon
